acceptance_gate: developmental traits remain separate from accepted environment/resource truth
IndividualSeed is deterministic and does not change inherited genome
one generator produces continuous morphology transitions without canonical TREE/BUSH/GRASS types
realized phenotype may change with EnvironmentSample while inherited genome/development checksums remain unchanged
PH3 consumes accepted P1 resource truth by checksum without modifying its equations
height, crown spread and branching each have measurable benefit/cost trade-offs
bigger is always better is rejected
PH3C resource-only controls remain neutral while morphology-aware cases diverge
PH3C proves at least one environment-dependent selection reversal with the same morphology pair
seed payload carries heredity but no GrowthGraph/phenotype/mesh
dormancy advances chronological age without advancing development age
offspring regenerate phenotype from local environment through PH2
renderer/mesh/LOD changes cannot modify ecology/genome/GrowthGraph/resource truth hashes
